propositions: T5c security findings must be grounded in the current codebase and configuration via read tools, overriding the shared preamble's evaluate-as-written stance
T5c must emit at most one undeclared-access-posture finding per plan, folding additional surfaces into evidence rather than creating duplicate findings
T5c candidate findings citing neither a read repo artifact nor a quoted plan sentence must be pressed at MINOR severity, demoted but never suppressed
Only two HIGH-class findings warrant severity >= major: plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces; all other T5c findings are at most minor
T5c routing entry must change from advisory @ 0.95 to blocking @ 0.9 with default_posture blocking, with no inert blocking_enabled key
All pinned blocking-set assertions and bfa8 parametrizations must include T5c, and the criteria guide must be regenerated to reflect the new rubric
